messages.speaker: Marcus Lee
messages.content: After the stampede fix, the hit ratio is stable at 91 percent. Origin load is still highest at midday.

messages.speaker: Priya Raman
messages.content: The proposal in DOC-009 asked for 1200, but that is untested. I would rather make a smaller step.

messages.speaker: Marcus Lee
messages.content: 900 seconds is a moderate increase. Product data rarely changes more often than every 15 minutes.

messages.speaker: Priya Raman
messages.content: Decision: catalog TTL becomes 900 seconds. Tracked in TKT-115. Session TTL stays unchanged for now.
